body:
WHAT
TaskList prints every task on one line: '#id [status] (owner: x) subject (blocked by: ids)'. For pending tasks the status tag is computed: 'pending READY' when every task in blockedBy is completed, otherwise 'pending BLOCKED by #ids' naming only the blockers that are still open.

WHY
Without the computed tag the agent would pick tasks in creation order and start work whose prerequisites are unfinished.

WHERE
engine/tools/src/tasks.ts — taskListTool (empty listSchema, permissionClass 'read'), execute(): byId map, openBlockers = blockedBy.filter(status !== 'completed'), READY/BLOCKED formatting. Data from engine/core/src/state/taskStore.ts — TaskStore.list().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Empty store: TaskList content is 'The task list is empty.'.
2. Create 1, 2, 3 with 3 blockedBy [1, 2]; assert the line for #3 contains 'pending BLOCKED by #1, #2' and #1 and #2 show 'pending READY'.
3. Mark task 1 completed; assert #3 now shows 'BLOCKED by #2' only; mark 2 completed; assert #3 shows 'pending READY' even though it was created after them.
4. Create task 2 that blocks task 1 (addBlocks ['1'] on 2); assert #1 (created first) is BLOCKED by #2 — declaration order does not decide readiness.
5. Set owner 'bob' on a task; assert its line contains '(owner: bob)' and the trailing '(blocked by: ...)' list mirrors blockedBy ids.
